summary: PR-1910 raises the payments standard (non-privileged) idle timeout from 30 to 45 minutes in both code and the approved parameter file. No catalog obligation bounds the standard timeout, and the privileged timeout stays at 15, as the passing exhaustive SES-1 control test confirms. The process records are complete: an approved ticket covering both components, an independent code review, a control-owner approval from outside the author's team for the protected policy value, all on the head commit, and a green full CI run on that commit. No security-sensitive component is touched, and no ledger evidence lapses.
